comments.note:
[Pedagogy audit v2 · New question to decide] For the type count gap (percentage-from-graph). Comparison score 33, between p13-q7 and p12-q4: Read four bars, total them, then convert to percentages. Part c needs the sum of two bars or a complement, giving a non-integer 31.25%. This is a little more than p13-q7's percentages, and there is no scale trap.
Proposed question: The graph shows the favourite sport of each student in Year 8.
a) How many students are there in total?
b) What percentage of students chose football?
c) What percentage of students chose neither netball nor football?
(with a diagram)
Answers: a) 80 students; b) $37.5\%$; c) $31.25\%$
